note: No fact: every system the report describes is outside class emis. The EMIS and the cancelled DLI 5 are described as annual school-level data collection (school-level information entered once a year by 31 March), which is the census; nothing is said of per-learner records, attendance or results entered by schools, nor of how schools keep learner records. Figures a census reading would carry: the indicator 'percentage of schools for which current year education indicators are net-accessible to decision makers' stood at 0 against a target of 90 in June 2024; DLR 5.2 (mobile entry in at least 90% of schools) and the 20% dashboard-use result were cancelled by the government on 27 June 2024 for implementation delays; UNESCO completed 15 of 34 agreed EMIS deliverables; baseline for DLI 5 was 'no integrated information system in place'. Read whole, in three reads.
